description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultMessageMapperFactory class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.mapping package. It tests creation, loading, and registry functions of message mappers within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity service, using JUnit and Mockito for testing.

classes.name: DefaultMessageMapperFactoryTest
classes.description: A final class containing unit tests for the DefaultMessageMapperFactory, verifying mapper loading, creation, and registry functionalities.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, sets up configuration and actor system before all tests.

methods.name: shutDownActorSystem
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after all tests have run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test instance before each test method.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test instance after each test method.

methods.name: loadMapperFromFactoryMethod
methods.description: Tests loading a mapper via factory method by checking its presence.

methods.name: loadMapperFromClass
methods.description: Tests loading a mapper directly from class.

methods.name: loadMapperWitInvalidOptions
methods.description: Tests behavior when invalid options are provided for loading a mapper.

methods.name: loadMissingMapper
methods.description: Tests behavior when attempting to load a non-existent mapper.

methods.name: loadNonMessageMapperClass
methods.description: Ensures that loading a class that isn't a MessageMapper returns empty.

methods.name: createWithFactoryMethod
methods.description: Verifies creation of a MessageMapper instance via factory method.

methods.name: createWithClassName
methods.description: Verifies creation of a MessageMapper instance by class name.

methods.description: Checks behavior when class name does not correspond to a class.

methods.description: Ensures failure when class name does not correspond to a MessageMapper subclass.

methods.name: loadMapperWithInvalidConfig
methods.description: Tests loading a mapper with invalid configuration insights.

methods.name: loadMapperWithoutContentType
methods.description: Tests behavior when no content type is specified for a mapper.
